neighbouring_scope.note: Grades 1/2 introduce number representations, arithmetic to 100, the small multiplication table, inverse division and simple two-choice combinations. This batch extends systematic enumeration to three choices and explicit restrictions, and connects divisors/multiples with rest 0. Prime factors, formal divisibility rules, gcd/lcm, negatives and Grade 5 term rules remain outside scope. Annual coverage and primary-school teacher approval remain incomplete.
